name: io.github.WYRE-AI/watchguard-cloud-mcp
title: WatchGuard Cloud
description: MCP server for WatchGuard Cloud's account, activation, and operator APIs.

environmentVariables.name: WATCHGUARDCLOUD_ACCESS_ID
environmentVariables.description: WatchGuard Cloud API Access ID (read-write), from Account Settings > API Access.

environmentVariables.name: WATCHGUARDCLOUD_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: WatchGuard Cloud API Password (read-write) paired with the Access ID.

environmentVariables.name: WATCHGUARDCLOUD_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: WatchGuard-API-Key generated when API access is enabled in WatchGuard Cloud.

environmentVariables.name: WATCHGUARDCLOUD_REGION
environmentVariables.description: WatchGuard Cloud account data-storage region: usa (default), deu (EMEA), or jpn (APAC).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
